source_of_truth: GitHub main and ERA33 Phase1-3 artifacts
scope: Define the concrete metadata-only review queue data contract for ERA33 Attention Engine. No CORE change. No runtime trade authority. No attack classification.

field_rules.event_id: Stable unique id for review queue item; must not encode attack classification.
field_rules.address: Token, contract, wallet or pool address when available; metadata only.
field_rules.tx_hash: Optional transaction hash; evidence pointer only.
field_rules.block_number: Optional block number; evidence pointer only.
field_rules.signal_family: Allowed family label, not attack type.
field_rules.urgency_band: LOW, MEDIUM or HIGH only. This is review priority, not risk score.
field_rules.review_reason: Human-readable reason for review without prediction or classification.
field_rules.missing_evidence: List of evidence still required before any ERA32 truth decision.
field_rules.expires_at: UTC expiry after which the item must be ignored or refreshed.

forbidden_behaviors: Do not classify events as attacks.
Do not generate risk scores or confidence scores.
Do not influence ERA32 final decision authority.
Do not write to wallet, trade, order, signing or live execution paths.
Do not require external API access in this contract phase.
Do not modify CORE or canonical root files.

ignore_capability.rule: Every ERA33 queue item must be safely ignorable by ERA32 and by downstream systems.

example_valid_item.review_reason: Liquidity metadata changed and requires evidence review.
